label: Synthetic demonstration data
disclaimer: A control mapping is an internal readiness view. It is not ISO/IEC 42001 certification.

records.evidence_note: RACI and risk themes defined; completed AI risk register and approved residual-risk acceptance not yet evidenced.

records.control_title: Data for AI systems (as referenced in the portfolio)
records.evidence_note: PII and financial data scope identified; lineage, sanitization, retention mapping and validation evidence not provided.

records.control_title: Logging and monitoring (as referenced in the portfolio)
records.evidence_note: Monitoring is in target design; telemetry coverage, alert thresholds and retained results not evidenced.

records.control_title: AI system impact assessment (as referenced in the portfolio)
records.evidence_note: Partial — business-impact evidence accepted; bias and fairness assessment remains missing.

records.control_title: Security of AI systems (as referenced in the portfolio)
records.evidence_note: Gateway and hardening requirements described; vulnerability, prompt-injection and model-weight integrity evidence incomplete.

records.control_title: AI system transparency (as referenced in the portfolio)
records.evidence_note: Purpose and users defined; model card, limitation guidance, training materials and acknowledgements not evidenced.

records.control_title: Verification and validation (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: UAT covers the 50 most common questions; reliability, robustness and adversarial testing still needed.

records.control_title: Data quality evaluation (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: Fine-tuning documents reviewed for accuracy; no repeatable data-quality and bias assessment.

records.control_title: AI system accountability (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: System Profile section 2.0 and charter AI-GOV-01 designate the Director of Digital Customer Experience as AI System Owner.

records.control_title: Data sourcing (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: Internal fine-tuning sources identified; the public base dataset lacks origin documentation.

records.control_title: Information for users (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: No end-user documentation of function, capabilities or limitations.

records.control_title: Informing people they interact with AI (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: Greeting never explicitly identifies the assistant as AI.

records.control_title: Incident management for AI systems (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: Corporate IT incident process covers outages only; AI output incidents not covered.

records.control_title: Intended use (as referenced in the matrix)
records.evidence_note: Intended use documented; unintended, inappropriate and prohibited uses not documented.
